name: Black Pearl Ann Arbor
direction: Editorial, photo-forward, Gramercy-Tavern-inspired warmth translated to a contemporary-American / sushi / seafood brand. Restrained palette, classical serif display, slow-paced reveal animations on scroll.
palette_notes: Cream paper background echoes Gramercy Tavern. Deep teal/near-black (accent_deep) nods to oyster-shell / pearl. Brass is used only for small accents and underline CTAs — NOT for headings. Card_dark is the hero overlay color used on darker sections (private events, CTA blocks).

display.family: 'Cormorant Garamond', 'EB Garamond', Garamond, 'Times New Roman', serif
display.transform: uppercase on section labels; normal case on section titles

typography_notes: All-Inter body per memory. Serif is Cormorant Garamond — editorial, slightly more contemporary than Trajan, works for both luxury and approachable tones.

components.header: Sticky transparent-to-cream on scroll. Left: wordmark 'BLACK PEARL' in display serif, tracked. Center: nav (MENUS · GREENHOUSE · PRIVATE EVENTS · ABOUT · CONTACT). Right: RESERVE button (bordered).
components.hero: Full-viewport background image with subtle darkening gradient from bottom. Centered uppercase eyebrow label, large serif title, narrow-column subtitle, bordered CTA. Fades up on load.
components.section_label: Small caps sans, tracked, brass or ink color, horizontal rule above it. Always paired with a serif section title below.
components.card_two_up: Gramercy Tavern pattern: two images side-by-side with overlaid title block (bordered, centered), single CTA. Used on Home to split Dining Room / Greenhouse.
components.menu_item: Row with name + price separated by leader dots or just space-between. Description in lighter italic serif. No photos inline — photography lives in hero/spacer blocks between sections.
components.cta_button: Transparent background, 1px brass or ink border, 14px uppercase Inter tracking 0.24em, 18px vertical / 32px horizontal padding.
components.inline_link: 1px underline in brass, underline-offset 4px, no color change on hover other than slight opacity.

motion.scroll_reveal: Every eyebrow, title, paragraph, image, and card uses IntersectionObserver to fade-and-slide-up on enter (20px translateY → 0, 700ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1), staggered 80ms per child within a section).
motion.hero_load: Hero content fades up in staggered sequence on page load (eyebrow → title → subtitle → CTA).
motion.image_hover: Subtle 1.04x scale over 800ms on card imagery.
motion.nav_on_scroll: Transparent at top. Background fades to cream with thin bottom rule after 80px scroll.

imagery_notes: Check aspect ratios before placing. Hero candidates are all landscape 3:2. Portraits are all ~2:3 — use in cards with object-fit: cover, top-aligned, never cropped at head. Do NOT hotlink — all images are local in assets/img/.
voice: Measured, grounded, first-person-plural when it fits. Avoid superlatives. Lean on verbs and specifics. Never invent reviews or awards.
do_not: Do not use emojis anywhere on the site
Do not invent press quotes, awards, or Zagat/Michelin mentions
Do not invent social media handles
Do not invent chef quotes beyond what's in verified-facts.md
Do not add a spirits list — replaced by Full Bar paragraph on cocktails page
Do not show any menu item without a price — all 167 items in menu-final.json are priced
